''See also: [[Awakening Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Awakening is a mysterious and permanent procedure used to transform inanimate objects into powerful, semi-conscious tools. While the process is poorly understood even by the most learned scholars in [[The Empire|the Empire]], it involves a Reader blending [[Intent]] from three distinct sources: the object itself, its owner, and [[the Reader]] performing the [[ritual]]. This process grants an item a rudimentary form of awareness or life related to its original purpose and allows it to utilize its stored [[Intent]] to achieve specific goals. Physically, Awakening can alter an object's appearance and structure to better align with its [[Intent]], though these changes occur only once during the process. The success and nature of an Awakening are influenced by the object's significance to both the owner and [[the Reader]], as well as its history; for instance, objects with a violent past may produce volatile or disturbing results. The procedure can take anywhere from days to years depending on the complexity and power of the item. If an Awakening is interrupted or attempted improperly, it can lead to unpredictable consequences, such as the object awakening on its own without guidance. Furthermore, a successful Awakening can result in a person becoming [[Soulbound]], creating a deep connection where they can draw power from the item. However, the process carries risks, including potential mental distortions for those nearby or permanent changes to the user's own mind.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Awakening is a method used by the Emperor on gravel and serves as a way to empower various objects. This process allows [[Intent]] to alter an object's physical nature and can grant a weapon entirely new powers. While it is used to bring an object to life through a Reader, the procedure remains not fully understood. Because Awakening is a permanent change, it makes a blade more powerful yet less predictable. Furthermore, if the [[Reading]] is not properly managed, a blade may even gain its own guidance.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Awakening]] is a process the Emperor uses on gravel.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c9">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Awakening]] is a process that allows an object's physical nature to be changed by [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c14">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Awakening]] is a process that is not yet fully understood.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Awakening]] is a permanent process that makes a blade more powerful but less predictable.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Awakening]] is the process of bringing an object to life through a Reader.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c19">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|An [[Awakening]] is a process where a blade can gain its own guidance if not properly managed during [[Reading]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Awakening]] is a process used to empower objects.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Awakening]] can grant a weapon powers it did not previously possess.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c25">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 25</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Awakening]] is a process of blending [[Intent]] from the object, its owner, and [[the Reader]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Awakening]] can be used to cover up imperfections in craftsmanship.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c18">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|No one, except perhaps the Emperor, has ever been sure exactly how [[Awakening]] works.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|If an object is significant to both [[the Reader]] and its owner, [[Awakening]] is more likely to succeed.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
